title: On finding the right career, the answer to anxiousness, and how to find your people
zh: 找到對的工作、面對焦慮、找到同類

ideas.en: If you hold on too tightly to something, you can't grow past it.
ideas.zh: 抓得太緊的東西，會讓你沒辦法超越它、繼續成長。

ideas.en: Every job has the same problems again and again. Pick work whose problems you actually enjoy solving.
ideas.zh: 每種工作都有反覆出現的麻煩；選一個你「享受解決那些麻煩」的工作。

ideas.en: Hard work can't promise success, but it gets you ready for the moment a chance appears.
ideas.zh: 努力不保證成功，但能讓你在機會出現時已經準備好。

quotes.who: Lorine Niedecker（引用 W. H. Hudson）
quotes.zh: 改變之前的不安，就像候鳥遷徙前的躁動——只有真的出發，不安才會消失。
父親告訴他：跑步不必等人陪，先自己跑，志同道合的人自然會跟上——人生很多事也一樣。

question.en: At this stage of your life, what would an inspiring way to live look like if you focused on just a few things?
question.zh: 在人生的這個階段，如果只專注在少數幾件事，什麼樣的生活方式會讓你感到振奮？

write: Write 3–5 sentences: What kind of problems do you enjoy solving? Which job or hobby might fit you?

title: On building a reserve of resilience, making habits easy, and the value of enthusiasm
zh: 存下韌性、讓習慣變簡單、熱情的價值

ideas.en: Practise while things are easy, so you are ready when things become hard.
ideas.zh: 在順利的時候多練習，困難來時才撐得住。

ideas.en: What you know becomes valuable when you share it with others.
ideas.zh: 知識要分享出去、變成別人能用的東西，才真正有價值。

ideas.en: Design habits so the good choice is also the easiest choice; then you need less motivation.
ideas.zh: 把好習慣設計成「最省力的選項」，就不必一直靠意志力。

quotes.zh: 做事時的熱情與活力，是通往成功的關鍵。
與其一直想著遙遠的終點，不如專心完成今天這一小段路。

question.en: Will the habits you have today take you to the future you want?
question.zh: 你現在的習慣，能帶你走向你想要的未來嗎？

write: Write 3–5 sentences: Describe one habit you have now. Will it help your future? How could you make a good habit easier?

title: On being proactive, learning to cook, and optimizing for impact over fame
zh: 主動出擊、學做菜、追求影響力而非名氣

ideas.en: Success that lasts usually needs a year or two of steady effort.
ideas.zh: 能持久的成功，通常需要一兩年穩定的努力。

ideas.en: Be fast by deciding early and fixing small problems before they grow — but don't rush carelessly.
ideas.zh: 要快，就早點做決定、趁問題還小時解決；但快不等於草率。

ideas.en: Your long-term goals should guide your short-term choices.
ideas.zh: 長期目標應該決定你眼前的每個小選擇。

quotes.zh: 學習最大的絆腳石是怕失敗；在廚房（和人生）裡要勇敢嘗試。
世界變好，很多時候靠的是默默、忠實過日子的平凡人，而不是名留青史的人。

question.en: Look at how you really spent your time this week. What were you learning?
question.zh: 看看你這週實際怎麼用時間——你其實在「學」什麼？

vocab: 主動的；積極預先處理的
write: Write 3–5 sentences: List what you spent the most time on this week. What did it teach you? Is that what you want to learn?

title: On refusing to give up, the refrains of nature, and making things fun
zh: 永不放棄、大自然的循環、讓事情變好玩

ideas.en: Decide early, so you can find mistakes and change direction sooner.
ideas.zh: 早點做決定，才能早點發現錯誤、修正方向。

ideas.en: Many good things start with a little discomfort, like the first minutes of exercise or a hard talk.
ideas.zh: 很多好事一開始都有點不舒服，像運動的頭幾分鐘、或一場難開口的對話。

ideas.en: Real success includes being happy with where you are now.
ideas.zh: 真正的成功，也包括對現在的自己感到滿足。

quotes.zh: 親近大自然能讓人恢復力量；季節總會循環，寒冬終會過去。

quotes.who: 相傳為 Marcus Aurelius（原文出處存疑）
quotes.zh: 只要你不放棄，失敗就只是心裡的感覺，不是結局。

question.en: How could your situation right now become fun?
question.zh: 你現在遇到的事，怎麼做可以變得好玩？

write: Write 3–5 sentences: Think of one boring or hard task you have. How could you make it more fun?
